title: [Installer] Preserve MSI file ownership with Smart Cabbing

proposed_comments.body:
### Report the Pester result instead of a negative test's native exit code

**Severity:** `high`

The new failure-path test deliberately leaves `$LASTEXITCODE=1`. All 16 Pester tests can pass, but Azure Pipelines' default PowerShell task epilogue still exits with that value, failing this step before the installer builds. Explicitly exit successfully only after this guard has confirmed every test ran and passed; the existing throw continues to reject failed or empty test runs.

```suggestion
      }
      exit 0
```

confidence.rationale: Exact-head Pester suite passes 16/16 but exits 1 under the Azure task epilogue on PS7 and PS5.1. Literal exit 0 insertion returns 0; failed-result and zero-test guards continue to fail.
